name: gift_of_paradise_on_opponents_land
notes: Printed: 'Enchant land. When this Aura enters, you gain 3 life. Enchanted land has "{T}: Add two mana of any one color."' P0 casts it on P1's Forest: P0 (the Aura's controller) gains 3. The granted ability belongs to the land, so P1, its controller, uses it: on P1's turn its two red pay Pack Mastiff's {1}{R} exactly (Mana abilities are no menu rows (2026-11-11): a game activates one only while a cost is paid, the payer choosing the source and its colour (CR 605.3a), so the pack pays through a cast with "tap": true or the menu (act)).
